hardware: 2x H100 80GB SXM5, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,0, same host and CPU budget
additional_control: nt-lru on p512 in both launches

llama_pilot.workload: p128 prefix and 16 consumed continuation tokens
llama_pilot.score: median of warm prefill_seconds + 4 * decode_seconds; rounds 1 and 2
llama_pilot.failure_policy: Only explicit CUDA OOM marks a pilot infeasible; other failures stop the worker

order: Reverse engine order on the second launch; alternate initial order by workload
cache_protocol: Clear sequence/KV state per request; retain each engine's weights/cache; do not flush the global OS file cache
cold_results: Diagnostic only: OS cache state is not controlled; record phase page faults and I/O blocks
quality: Same 65 target tokens and full vocabulary logits; finite/repeat checks, NLL and KL; no bitwise cross-engine requirement or task-quality certification
scope: A bounded native-configuration comparison, not exhaustive tuning or equal VRAM allocation
